en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm waterfront scene with sailboats on a bay or archipelago. In the background there is a two‑storey wooden house on a small peninsula or island. In the foreground, rocky shorelines and trees frame the view, with a large boat pulled up on land to the right and small rowboats near the water's edge. At the bottom left, the printed caption reads "Wasa", and beneath the image there is a handwritten greeting in cursive.
